name: Decaying Winter: Eternal Fools
desc:
NOTICE: This game is built from ~2 years worth of sticks and rocks. While it would be nice to recode and refactor everything with my much more modern coding skills, it will take a significantly long time, which I'd rather spend on working on newer games. Please AVOID EXPECTATIONS FOR ANY UPDATES beyond bug fixes (thanks Roblox) or minor adjustments.

I am the only developer for this game and I don't plan otherwise.

A Decaying Winter fangame where April Fools has been misplaced...

Made using MY FRAMEWORK.
Credits to Decaying Winter for some assets. I tried my best so that most models in-game are remade or substituted with similar models. None of the source code is based on or taken from Decaying Winter's.

Fangame of...
Decaying Winter Reupload Link: https://www.roblox.com/games/13438553315/Decaying-Winter
